name: linux-inspector-ylang
description: Read-only Linux system diagnostics MCP server implemented in YLang 2.3.
long_description: A native Linux MCP server with tools for distribution, kernel, CPU, memory, uptime, load, loaded modules, mounts, network counters, disk statistics, and memory pressure. The server reads OS metadata and procfs streams only; it does not invoke shell commands or modify the system.

tools.name: cpu_info
tools.description: Read CPU model, topology, and feature information.

tools.name: uptime_info
tools.description: Read system uptime and idle-time counters.

tools.name: load_average
tools.description: Read load averages and scheduler counts.

tools.name: mounts_info
tools.description: Read the current process mount table.
